```lean
:= by
  have h_partition : Iic y = Iio z ∪ Icc z y := 
    by rw [Iic_def, Iio_def, Icc_def]; exact union_Iio_Icc
  have h_disjoint : Disjoint Iio z Icc z y := by apply disjoint_Iio_Icc
  have h_meas : MeasurableSet (Iio z) ∧ MeasurableSet (Icc z y) := 
    by exact (measurable_Iio _).prod (measurable_Icc _ _)
  have h_add : ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Iic y, f x = ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Iio z, f x + ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Icc z y, f x :=
    by apply integral_add; exact h_partition; exact h_disjoint; exact h_meas
  exact h_add
```
